description: Bounded implementation and verification tasks for the documented AcademIA Sprint 1 scope.

tasks.description: Establish a safe feature-branch starting point without losing existing work.
tasks.reason: The requested implementation must be based on develop, while the repository currently contains pre-existing local changes that must be preserved.
tasks.requirements: Before any branch operation, inspect git status --short --branch and local branch availability. Confirm develop exists and identify all pre-existing tracked and untracked changes. Preserve them exactly and proceed only if they can be safely preserved while creating or switching to a feature branch based on develop whose name includes joselyn-redroban (for example, feature/joselyn-redroban-academia-sprint1). If develop is unavailable or safe preservation cannot be confirmed, stop and report the blocker. Do not clean, overwrite, discard, commit, or push pre-existing work. Recheck the current state at execution time.

tasks.description: Complete and verify secure login and logout for the documented user roles.
tasks.reason: The Sprint 1 report requires credential-based access, role-bearing sessions, safe password storage, and session termination; the current login view only navigates to courses.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-01 and RF-01/RN-01 only. Implement the report's valid and invalid credential behavior, a session token containing the user's role, hashed passwords, and logout that removes the client session and protects private routes. Invalid usernames and passwords must produce the same message and no token. Add focused tests for valid credentials, invalid credentials, password-hash storage, and logout/private-route behavior. Use anonymized test data and never place credentials or tokens in source control.

tasks.description: Restrict protected operations and visible options by role and authorized course.
tasks.reason: Sprint 1 requires minimum-privilege access and course-level privacy, neither of which is established by the current unauthenticated UI.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-02 and RN-02/RN-03. Require valid authentication for protected endpoints and routes; return 401 for missing/invalid sessions and 403 for authenticated users without permission. A teacher must see only assigned courses and students and must not gain access by requesting another course identifier directly. Restrict Moodle configuration and synchronization options to the technical administrator, including in the server authorization policy and role-specific navigation. Add tests for 401, 403, course isolation, and role-specific navigation.

tasks.description: Complete administrator-managed Moodle configuration and connection verification.
tasks.reason: The report requires a verifiable Moodle connection and safe handling of its technical credential; current code reads settings but does not provide the documented verification flow.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-03 and RN-04. Allow only the technical administrator to manage the Moodle URL and verify connectivity. Read the technical token from environment configuration; never return it in API responses or the UI, and never write it to logs or source-controlled files. Report successful connection with the Moodle site name and response time; distinguish inaccessible URL and rejected credentials with useful, non-sensitive errors. Add tests for success, connection failure, rejected token, and forbidden teacher access.

tasks.description: Complete idempotent synchronization of Moodle courses and enrolled students.
tasks.reason: The existing API has a single-course synchronization path, while HU-04 also requires enrolled-student persistence, repeatability, synchronization history, and paginated results.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-04 and RN-05/RN-06/RN-11. Synchronize permitted course and enrollment data to SQL Server, update existing records rather than duplicating them on repeated runs, and record each run's timestamp, outcome, and errors. Provide a paginated way to inspect synchronization results. Handle Moodle permissions or unavailable data without claiming it was imported. Add tests for mapping, persistence, repeated synchronization without duplicates, history contents, and pagination.

tasks.description: Complete grade-item and activity-state synchronization with truthful missing-data handling.
tasks.reason: The repository has a Moodle grades path, but the report's scale, activity state, incomplete-run, and administrative status requirements still need end-to-end verification.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-05 and RN-05 through RN-08/RNF-03. Persist grade items with their Moodle-provided scales, grades, and the documented activity states; preserve an absent grade as unavailable rather than converting it to zero. Record errors and mark a run incomplete when Moodle denies or fails to provide required data. Show administrators the last-run time, status, and error details. Add tests for scale mapping, valid zero versus missing grade, activity states, incomplete runs, and safe error presentation.

tasks.description: Provide the authorized course and student listing required by Sprint 1.
tasks.reason: The current course screen lists synchronized courses but does not satisfy the report's complete teacher course-selection and student-listing criteria.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-06 and RN-02/RN-11. Let an authenticated teacher select only an authorized course and period, then view its students in a paginated list with name search and the report's with/without-grades filter. Enforce authorization in the API, not only in the UI, and return 403 for a direct request to an unauthorized course. Add tests for course scope, pagination, search, filter behavior, and unauthorized access.

tasks.description: Replace demonstration dashboard values with transparent indicators from synchronized data.
tasks.reason: The current dashboard contains hard-coded demonstration grades and metrics, whereas HU-07 requires calculated indicators tied to Moodle data.
tasks.requirements: Address HU-07 and RN-07/RN-08/RN-09. Calculate and display the course average with its explicit Moodle grade scale, grade distribution, evaluated-activity count, and available progress from persisted data. Show Moodle as the source and the last synchronization date. When data is missing or synchronization is incomplete, show a clear warning and unavailable values as 'sin datos'; do not invent, default, or present misleading metrics. Add unit tests for known inputs, scale handling, and incomplete/no-data cases.

tasks.description: Verify the Sprint 1 end-to-end flow and record only evidence-backed outcomes.
tasks.reason: The report defines 29 acceptance criteria and 14 test cases but currently has no recorded execution outcomes.
tasks.requirements: Run the documented checks across authentication, authorization, Moodle connection, course/enrollment synchronization, grades/activity states, student listing, and indicators. Map test output and observable API/database/UI evidence to the report's 29 acceptance criteria and execute/record the 14 documented test cases. Build the .NET solution and frontend and run the available backend tests and frontend lint/build. Use a test Moodle instance and SQL Server when available; otherwise use mocked Moodle responses for applicable tests and mark environment-dependent cases blocked rather than passed. Do not alter or invent retrospective answers, actual Sprint metrics, or any result lacking evidence; preserve the existing report file.

tasks.description: Assess dependency vulnerabilities and remediate only confirmed findings relevant to the application.
tasks.reason: Security and minimum-privilege handling are explicit Sprint 1 non-functional requirements; a bounded dependency review is also required by this plan-generation workflow.
tasks.requirements: Review the backend and frontend dependency manifests for known vulnerabilities. Remediate only confirmed vulnerable dependencies with compatible patched versions, avoiding unrelated upgrades or scope expansion. Rebuild and rerun available tests after changes, and report findings that cannot be safely resolved without guessing. Do not expose secrets or change application behavior outside the Sprint 1 scope.
